scope: FY2024 extraction limited to properties.json, property_transactions.json, and reconciliation notes.

sources.properties_audited_tier_c: Investment Properties Portfolio Statement Datalab pages 113-125; carrying amounts in $'000 rescaled x1000 to absolute SGD. Operating/property metrics (GFA, NLA, gross revenue, occupancy) and purchase prices from the property listing (financial review) Datalab pages 44-69 where disclosed.
sources.local_currency_values: Portfolio Statement discloses each foreign property's LOCAL-currency carrying amount in parentheses next to the SGD $'000 figure: Australia (A$) pages 116-117, United States (USD) pages 122-124, United Kingdom/Europe (GBP/EUR) pages 118-121. original_currency/original_value/market_valuation_currency captured for all 133 foreign operating rows (34 AUD, 48 USD, 42 GBP, 7 EUR, plus 2 IPUD with no 2024 local figure). Wave: AUD local values recovered 2026-07-07 (were previously null); 34 rows sum to A$2,535,560,000 = disclosed Total Australia investment properties.
sources.ipud: Note 5 Investment Properties Under Development (detail table Datalab page 153) for 27 IBP (S$59.35m), 5 Toh Guan Road East (S$85.0m), Welwyn Garden City (S$108.064m), Summerville Logistics Center (S$16.32m). Welwyn tenure (Freehold) recovered from Portfolio Statement page 120.
sources.transactions: Completed divestments table page 28; acquisitions/ongoing projects pages 22-28; Note 11 held-for-sale support pages 156-157.

reconciliation.gross_revenue_note: Sum of 225 as-disclosed per-property gross revenues (0.1M-precision figures from the property listing) is S$1,516.3m vs audited Note 19 total S$1,523.046m; ~S$6.7m gap is rounding plus the divested trio/21 Jalan Buroh and IPUD timing. Figures are as-disclosed only, not scaled to tie.
reconciliation.count_basis: 229 independent valuations disclosed on page 125 = 225 operating investment properties plus 4 investment properties under development/redevelopment.
reconciliation.category_mapping: Canonical property categories use schema/models.py values: Industrial and Logistics rows mapped to Industrial & Logistics; data centres mapped to Data Centers; verbatim segment retained in category_raw.

columns_never_fillable.evidence: Genuinely NOT disclosed per property. Pages checked: property listing Datalab pages 44-69 disclose only GFA, NLA, Address, Gross Revenue and Occupancy per property (no NPI column); Note 31 Operating Segments (Datalab page 198) reports gross revenue, property operating expenses and net property income only by 3 asset-type segments (Business Space & Life Sciences / Industrial & Data Centres / Logistics), not per property; Note 19 Gross Revenue (page 172) and Note 20 Property Operating Expenses (page 172) are consolidated totals only. No per-property property-income note exists in this report.
No per-property NPI contribution percentage disclosed; NPI is reported only at the 3-segment level (Note 31, page 198).

Portfolio Statement pages 113-125 disclose 'Percentage of net assets attributable to unitholders' (a portfolio-weight column, NOT an ownership stake); no per-property ownership percentage is disclosed. All 229 properties are presented at Group carrying amount as wholly-owned; the only sub-100% asset (1 Science Park Drive, 34% stake redevelopment) is a JV project not among the 229 rows.
Property listing pages 44-69 and portfolio pages 26-41 disclose customers' industry mix by geography/segment and the REIT-level top-10 customers, not named major tenants by individual property.
Property listing discloses GFA and NLA per property (captured), never a distinct GLA figure.
Portfolio Statement discloses acquisition date, tenure, term of lease and lease expiry, but not the land-lease start/effective date.

columns_never_fillable.column: gross_revenue / occupancy_rate / gfa / nla (IPUD rows only)
columns_never_fillable.evidence: 27 IBP, 5 Toh Guan Road East, Welwyn Garden City and Summerville Logistics Center are under development/redevelopment at 31 Dec 2024; the property listing (pages 45, 50, 65) shows dashes for their GFA/NLA/Gross Revenue/Occupancy, so these are genuinely absent, not omitted.

Summerville is a ground-up development; the report discloses only an estimated investment cost (S$94.8m, page 23/26) and a land valuation (S$8.5m as at 28 Aug 2024, page 23) - neither is an acquisition cost, and no acquisition/completion date is disclosed. Not used as a purchase_price proxy per schema guidance.

parsing_traps: 38A Kim Chuan Road audited line is Datalab-merged; split into Kim Chuan Telecommunications Complex (S$151.1m) and 38A Kim Chuan Road (S$137.9m), with Telepark separately at S$269.7m.
21 Changi North Rise audited rows are Datalab-merged/blank; mapped first component at 11 Changi North Rise to Hamilton Sundstrand Building (S$54.6m) and second to 21 Changi North Rise (S$19.0m).
27 International Business Park, 5 Toh Guan Road East and Welwyn Garden City show dash in operating card/Portfolio Statement but are IPUD in Note 5; Summerville exists only as IPUD/ongoing project.

Datalab garbles some overseas listing currency headers ('A$'/'S$' rendered as '$$'); property-listing Gross Revenue is in SGD across all regions (region totals sum to the audited SGD Note 19 total), while Portfolio Statement local-currency values in parentheses use explicit A$/USD/GBP/EUR tags.
transaction_notes: Australian trio sale consideration S$64.2m (aggregate for the three properties) and gain S$0.628m are disclosed only in aggregate; each of the three property rows repeats aggregate figures with carrying_value_basis noting non-allocation. Individual valuations and carrying values are source-disclosed.

21 Jalan Buroh (Singapore) divestment: gross_sale_price S$112.8m and carrying_value S$67.5m disclosed (page 28); per-deal gain not disclosed (only aggregate gain on disposal S$45.362m in Note 31), so gain_on_divestment left null rather than computed.
DHL Indianapolis Logistics Center is disclosed as completed post-FY2024 (15 Jan 2025), included as a source-grounded subsequent-event acquisition row; not counted as completed FY2024 acquisition.
Summerville Logistics Center is included as acquisition/development transaction because pages 22-23 disclose FY2024 acquisition/development project and Note 5 discloses FY2024 IPUD carrying value.
